title: Call for 15 student volunteers
author: Branch Executive Committee
summary: The branch is looking for 15 Cavendish University Uganda students to help run the Official Branch Launch on 4 November 2026. Applications close 27 October.
content:
The IEEE Student Branch at Cavendish University Uganda is looking for 15 student volunteers to help make the Official Branch Launch a success.

The call is open to every CUU student, from any faculty and any year. You do not need IEEE membership or technical skills. Volunteers will help with registration and ushering, logistics, media and photography, social content, tech and live updates, and mobilisation before the day.

Applications close on 27 October 2026 at 11:59 PM EAT. Selected volunteers will be contacted before the launch and invited to a short briefing.

See the roles and apply on the Volunteer page: /volunteer
